                print(f'  WARNING: {strategy}_{s} phase={phase} sparsity={sparsity_val} not found. Keys: {list(ii.get(phase, {}).keys())}')

    def safe_grad(row, field):

    def fmt(v):

    print(f'{s:<12} {fmt(ig_mean)} {fmt(rg_mean)} {fmt(ig_med)} {fmt(rg_med)}')
